Field Descriptions

SHA256_WHITENING_ENABLE

Enable SHA-256 whitening stage after BIW compression. When enabled, 16 × 32-bit BIW outputs (512 bits) are accumulated and hashed using SHA-256, producing 8 × 32-bit digest words (256 bits). This provides cryptographic conditioning per NIST SP 800-90B. When disabled, BIW output goes directly to FIFO (passthrough mode). Default=1 (enabled).

DOWNSAMPLE_RATE

Downsample Rate for the decorrelator output. Specifies additional clock cycles to wait between entropy byte outputs. Value of N means output every (N+1) cycles. Applied after DECORRELATOR_CTRL.SAMPLE_CLK_DIV. Example: if SAMPLE_CLK_DIV=63 (div64) and DOWNSAMPLE_RATE=3, effective rate is div256 (64*(3+1)). Default=0 (no additional downsampling).

BYPASS_ENTROPY_COMPRESSOR

Bypass Entropy Compressor (BIW extractor) when asserted high. When bypassed, all 96 bytes from the 12 generators (8 bytes each) are pushed directly into the FIFO without compression, increasing FIFO fill rate by 3x (96 bytes vs 32 bits per cycle). Used for raw entropy analysis and testing. Disabled by default (32-bit compressed output).

AUTOTUNE_ENABLE

Enable automatic detuning of individual ring oscillator noise generators when corresponding per-generator health tests fail. When enabled, a failing health test causes the generator's noise RO to switch to its detuned (higher frequency) tap point. The shared sampling RO also detunes if ANY generator requests it. Automatic detuning is disabled by default (manual tuning via RING_OSC_TUNE required).

RESET

Software controlled reset when asserted high. Resets all internal state including health test counters, FIFO pointers, and decorrelator shift registers. Ring oscillators continue running. Self-clearing after 1 clock cycle.
